title: An analysis of heart and head metaphors in English and Arabic
core_idea: To examine how heart and head metaphors are conceptualized and received in American English and Jordanian Arabic, highlighting similarities and differences and exploring how embodied human body experiences influence the formation of such expressions.
tldr: Compare conceptualization and reception of heart and head metaphors in American English and Jordanian Arabic, using Lakoff and Johnson's framework on a 140-expression corpus to highlight cross-language similarities, differences, and the role of bodily experience.
